paper_metadata.title: Optimization mechanism of mechanical properties in TC4 titanium alloy via Si/Y co-doping

evidence.quote: In the present work, the effects of Si and Y co-doping on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloys were investigated.
